title: Elastic Priority Curve for inference deployment regimes (RICE + token-cost slope + latency bands)
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Problem: Current RICE runs into edge cases when inference unit economics and latency SLOs conflict. Simple RICE ranks high-ROI features that dramatically increase token spend or push latency into higher SLO bands, causing operational churn and missed SLA objectives. Goal: Define and prototype an extensible prioritization curve that blends RICE with continuous cost slopes and latency-sensitivity bands so PMs can rank initiatives by net operational cost, latency risk, and product value in one single score.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New scoring formula documented and reviewed by PM/Eng/Design; 2) Prototype spreadsheet applied to last 12 roadmap decisions with annotated deltas; 3) Integrated scoring widget (read-only) added to roadmap ticket UI; 4) Two pilot initiatives prioritized with the new curve and outcomes tracked over one cycle; 5) Guideline doc published in Confluence and shared at PM guild review.
implementation_plan: Phase 0: Research & formula design (2w) — collect historical initiative data, token-econ deltas, and latency outcomes. Phase 1: Prototype (1w) — spreadsheet + visualization; share with PM guild and Runtime lead. Phase 2: Engineering integration (3w) — lightweight scoring widget in Linear roadmap view, backend service to compute scores (can be a CRON job). Phase 3: Pilot & iterate (4–6w) — apply to two product areas (Console UX and Runtime prioritization), collect metrics. Artifacts: Confluence design doc: https://confluence.redwood.local/display/PM/EPC+Design, Prototype spreadsheet: https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_EPC_PROTOTYPE, GitHub PR for widget: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap-ui/pull/1426, Pilot dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/epc-pilot
notes: Design trade-off: prefer continuous penalties over hard buckets to avoid cliff-driven prioritization swings.
We will treat latency sensitivity as a multiplicative risk factor rather than an additive penalty to preserve RICE interpretability.
Requested runtime input from Eng: typical token-cost slopes per model family and capacity breakpoints.
Suggest adding a visualization that shows how score changes as token price or latency SLO shifts (interactive slider).

decision: Adopt 'Elastic Priority Curve' as an official supplement to RICE for Q2 pilot; compute an EPC score = RICE_score / (1 + token_cost_slope * alpha) * latency_multiplier where alpha is tunable per project and latency_multiplier is >1 for SLO-sensitive initiatives.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Non-technical PMs might mis-tune alpha and prune high-value features. Mitigation: ship safe defaults, add clear guidance and examples, and gate alpha changes behind PM guild approval. Risk: noisy token-cost estimates. Mitigation: use conservative upper-bound estimates from runtime, and surface sensitivity intervals in the widget.
